# trt

`trt` is the compiler for the TRT Programming Language, an experimental language
based on type theory

contributions are very welcome

## how to contribute

> we assume you already have rust, with an nightly toolchain installed

simply run `just setup`

if you don't have `just`, you can get it with `brew install just` or
`sudo apt install just` or `winget install Casey.Just`

all commands are ran with `just`, run `just` for everything you can do

see the [contributing guidelines](./CONTRIBUTING.md) next
